description: Bulk-create multiple task cards in one call — far cheaper than calling `create_task` N times. Pass `tasks`: an array of task objects, each with `column_id` (required) + the same fields `create_task` accepts (`name`, `description`, `due_date`, `priority`, `assignee`, `done`, `sort`). Returns the array of created ids in order. Stops at the first invalid item and reports its index; items before it are still created (not transactional).

access_key.description: 8-character lowercase alphanumeric board access key when the board is locked (legacy 6-character lowercase alphanumeric keys are also accepted). Equivalent to setting the `X-Board-Key` HTTP header on the JSON-RPC POST. Omit for unlocked boards. Obtain via POST /api/boards/<id>/lock.

author.description: Author tag applied to every task, defaults to ai:claude.

tasks.description: Array of task objects to create.

name: create_tasks
title: Create Tasks
